PLAYBOOK OF GOVERNMENT SCHEMES AND INITIATIVES FOR STARTUPS 
 
Page 55 of 107 
Acing Development of Innovative Technologies 
with iDEX (ADITI) 
Ministry of Defence / Defence Innovation Organisation (DIO) 
 
📌  WHAT IS 
THIS? 
ADITI is a government program that supports startups and innovators in 
building new defence and aerospace technologies so India can become more 
self‑reliant and technologically advanced. 
🎯  
OBJECTIVES 
• The ADITI Scheme aims to facilitate rapid development of strategically 
critical technologies which are sensitive and innovative from the defence 
perspective and required by the country.  
• Under this, relevant Challenges/Hackathons are organized for startups to 
seek solutions for problem statements pertaining to the earmarked 
technology. Winners of the ADITI challenges are incubated by Partner 
Incubators (PIs). 
✅  WHO 
CAN APPLY? 
• DPIIT recognised startups.  
• Any Indian company incorporated under the Companies Act 1956/2013.  
• Individual innovators can also apply. 
💰  WHAT DO 
YOU GET? 
• For Partner Incubators: The limit of payment amounting to ₹9 lakh per PI, 
based on facilitation/completion of each milestone of their associated 
challenge winner. 
• For Startups/Innovators: Quantum of Grant up to 50% of product 
development budget (PDB) with maximum limit of ₹25 crore, leading to a 
PDB around ₹50 crore or beyond. 
🚀  HOW TO 
APPLY 
• Visit https://idex.gov.in/ for more information. 
🔗  KEY 
LINKS
